complaint_text: Wrongful Tax Demand Resolved and Refund Issued. An employee of a public sector company received a tax demand notice of ₹1,77,740 for the financial year 2013–14, despite being eligible for relief under Section 89(1) due to arrears paid by the employer. Despite submitting all relevant documents to the Income Tax authorities multiple times, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking resolution, the individual filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. complaint_text: Refund Credited After Rectification of Missed Tax Credits. A taxpayer faced a delay in receiving a refund amounting to ₹83,080 for Assessment Years 2021–22 and 2022–23 due to missed credits for advance tax and TDS in the filed Income Tax Returns. After repeated attempts to resolve the issue, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. The matter was taken up by the concerned authorities, and a rectification order was issued crediting an advance tax payment of ₹65,000 and TDS of ₹54,272. With adjustments for regular tax and SAT, a final refund of ₹73,122 was determined and successfully credited to the taxpayer’s account in April 2024, closing the grievance.

complaint_text: TDS Mismatch Corrected and Large Refund Released. Despite having paid all taxes and filing multiple rectification requests, the issue remained unresolved, and subsequent refunds for AYs 2021–22 and 2022–23 was wrongly adjusted against this incorrect demand. complaint_text: Counterfeit Plywood Scam Busted After Grievance Escalation. A citizen who hired an interior design firm discovered that substandard and counterfeit ISI- marked materials were used instead of the agreed Wigwam brand BWP and MR grade plywood. Despite paying ₹6,78,000 through bank transfer, the individual did not receive a GST invoice. Faced with inaction, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal, seeking both a refund and regulatory intervention. The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) investigated the matter and conducted a raid, seizing 310 fake plywood sheets. Legal proceedings were subsequently initiated against the firm for fraudulent practices, ensuring consumer protection and accountability.

Despite entitlement, no pension was credited for eight months, and arrears amounting to over ₹1.29 lakh remained unpaid. Seeking resolution, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the intervention, the issue was resolved and a total arrear amount of ₹1,78,148 was credited to his bank account on 8 August 2024. He was advised to verify the credit by updating his bank passbook.

complaint_text: Incorrect Date of Birth in PPO Corrected After Two-Year Delay. A family pensioner, the wife of a deceased ex-serviceman, had been facing prolonged issues due to an error in her Pension Payment Order (PPO), which recorded her date of birth as 10/10/2001 instead of the correct 10/10/1982. Although the SPARSH system reflected the correct date, the discrepancy in the PPO hindered her ability to access essential services like the grocery card. After over two years of follow-ups without resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon verification, authorities corrected the date of birth and issued a revised PPO, effectively resolving the long-pending matter.

complaint_text: Loan Limit Activation Issue on Investment Platform Resolved After CPGRAMS Grievance. A citizen from Balasore, Odisha, faced an issue where a Loan Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) approved by DSP Finance did not reflect on a popular investment platform, preventing access to the loan limit. Despite multiple complaints and emails to the platform’s support team, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking redressal, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The matter was escalated to DSP Finance, which clarified that the delay was due to a pending lien marking confirmation that hindered system update. Following coordination between the financier and the platform, the issue was resolved. The citizen was able to submit and receive a withdrawal request of ₹3,64,613, and the grievance was successfully closed.

A concerned citizen from the medical community filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal regarding homeopathic “Insulin Tablets” manufactured by a Rajasthan-based company. The complaint highlighted that labelling the product as “Insulin” violated the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules and could mislead patients into replacing prescribed insulin injections with these tablets, potentially risking serious health consequences. Following the grievance, the matter was reviewed by the concerned authorities, and within a month, the manufacturing license for the product was cancelled.

complaint_text: PPF Account Transfer Finalized After Ledger Delay. A citizen submitted a request to transfer their Public Provident Fund (PPF) account from the Head Post Office in Sonipat, Haryana to a local Axis Bank branch. Although the initial request was made on 5th September 2024, the transfer was delayed by nearly two months. When documents were eventually sent, a key component—the detailed account statement from the account’s opening in 2003 to 2014—was missing, leaving the transfer process incomplete for over three months and causing significant distress. The citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. In response, the Haryana Postal Circle clarified that while the account had been transferred, the missing ledger had not reached the bank. The Postmaster of Sonipat HO confirmed that the ledger details were subsequently sent, thereby resolving the grievance.

complaint_text: Road Laid After Complaint on Poor PMGSY Road Quality. A citizen raised concerns about the poor quality of a newly re-laid road under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, which had been constructed without tar or bitumen. The metal road posed daily challenges for commuters, especially schoolchildren and two-wheeler riders. Seeking resolution, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Within just 16 days, the Additional Collector and Project Director in Thoothukudi reviewed the matter and confirmed that strengthening work on the Kootampuli to Sirupadu stretch had been sanctioned. Bituminous concrete was laid on March 14, 2024, and the road was made safe and motorable.

complaint_text: NFSC Fellowship Account Linking Approved After Escalation. Despite completing all required steps on the Canara Bank Scholarship Portal, the application was held up due to subject classification issues, causing uncertainty and delay in fellowship disbursement. Seeking resolution, the scholar filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. After review, the concerned authorities approved the account linking based on a formal clarification provided by the university registrar, enabling the scholar to access his NFSC fellowship.

complaint_text: Second Loan Disbursed Under PM SVANidhi After Grievance. complaint_text: Grievance on Unauthorized Median Opening Near Sriperumbudur Toll Plaza. An unauthorized median opening near a toll plaza on NH-48 in Tamil Nadu was causing frequent accidents due to its proximity to the toll collection area. Despite repeated alerts, the issue was left unaddressed, endangering commuters. Upon receiving a grievance through CPGRAMS, the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) took urgent action. Within 11 days, they coordinated with the contractor, who closed the unauthorized opening by installing a hard crash barrier. This corrective step mitigated the safety risk and ensured a safer commute for all travelers in the area.

The consumer was informed of the resolution, and the grievance was successfully closed.

Even after waiting for more than a month, there was no update or progress on the application, causing concern and inconvenience. To seek redressal, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the escalation, the concerned authorities reviewed the matter, processed the pending request, and approved the application. The grievance was accordingly resolved to the satisfaction of the complainant.

complaint_text: Discrepancy in Ayushman Bharat Card. A citizen from Ludhiana, Punjab, encountered a technical discrepancy while applying for his Ayushman Bharat card, wherein his wife’s Aadhaar number was incorrectly linked to his farmer ID. This error prevented him from completing the KYC verification process and availing the health scheme benefits. Faced with this roadblock, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal, seeking timely correction. Upon escalation, the concerned authorities reviewed and resolved the issue by rectifying the Aadhaar linkage in the system. The citizen was subsequently advised to generate his e-card through the Ayushman App or beneficiary portal. The grievance was successfully resolved.

complaint_text: Blocked Drain Cleared After Complaint Resolution. A resident of Mahu Kala, Gangapur City, Rajasthan, faced persistent inconvenience due to the blockage of a drainage line by nearby individuals. This led to the accumulation of wastewater on the road, creating unsanitary conditions for both local residents and passersby. The stagnant water emitted a foul smell and became a breeding ground for mosquitoes and flies, raising serious health concerns. To address the issue, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Following the complaint, the Gram Vikas Adhikari investigated the matter and ensured that the blocked drainage was thoroughly cleared. The problem was resolved, restoring sanitation and preventing further public health risks.
